t: You're looking at St Andrew Bobola Church, a Gothic Revival Roman Catholic church designed by Edmund Woodthorpe, close to Ravenscourt Park. It serves the Polish community in West London. The church is named for Andrew Bobola, a Polish Jesuit missionary who was tortured to death and canonised in 1938. People buried here include Zygmunt Szkopiak, who in 1986 became the last Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Polish government-in-exile in London, and Helena Kornella, described as the first female urologist in Poland.
